detail: Two Red Racer nerites found dead
note: Date approximate - reported after the fact. Two of three lost is a pattern rather than attrition. Staging KH measured 22 ppm (1.2 dKH) on 2026-09-05, below the species minimum, and a snail cannot maintain its shell in mineral-poor water.

detail: All remaining staging animals moved to the display tank: Neocaridina, mystery snails and the nerite
note: Staging is now empty. The display tank measured 161 ppm GH (9.0 dGH) on 2026-09-05, well above the molt floor the staging tank was under.
